why: A self-reference looks back at the field's own earlier value (L747-749), here at its fixed-up path; the fallback to the original path is for an included file that "might intend to refer to the application's root config" (L1043-1047), which a field referring to itself does not. typesafe/config reads it so: a += 3 included at k looks back at k.a only, which has no earlier value, so the root's text a = "" is not appended to and k.a is [3], no error.
